# Ceyo

> A workspace of personal bots and specialist teams that work on complete projects.

Ceyo brings together personal bots, group conversations, memory, web browsing, scheduled work, and connections to 1,000+ apps. Each bot has an isolated cloud computer and can specialize in research, marketing, programming, or creating and editing images and videos. External accounts must be connected and authorized by their owner. Ceyo also includes a built-in wallet and voice, phone, and video calls, subject to service availability and user permissions.

An active subscription is required before using bots and paid services. Web plans are Plus at $20/month or $199/year, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. External-service costs may apply. The landing sites are ceyo.si and ceyo.app; the web application is on web.ceyo.si and the Android application uses app.ceyo.si.
